body:
## What
- Template workflow generated by `hkb init --with-actions`: triggers `issues: [closed, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]`, `pull_request: [closed]`, `pull_request_review`, `workflow_run`, `workflow_dispatch`, plus `schedule: */15` as a sweeper only; `concurrency: {group: kb-dispatch-<board>, cancel-in-progress: false}`; runs `npx hkb dispatch --max 1` with `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.KB_TOKEN }}`.
- The Actions profile must not spawn local workers: add a `claude-action` profile whose launch dispatches `kanban-worker-claude.yml` via `gh workflow run` (worker workflow template included, using anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 with `prompt` = `hkb context`). Keep secrets out of templates.
- README section "Runs when the laptop is closed" with the honest latency statement from docs/EVALUATION.md.

## Done when
Workflows lint (`actionlint` if available, else YAML parse) and a dry run on this repo shows the dispatcher tick executing.
title: kanban-dispatch.yml: event-driven Actions dispatcher with a 15-minute sweeper
